name: Iris
desc: A macro portrait of the iris: radial trabecular fibres streaming out of the pupil through the pupillary ruff, crossing a zigzag collarette into the ciliary zone, broken by concentric contraction furrows and dark Fuchs' crypts and ringed by a dark limbus — the pupil breathing continuously as the light reflex and hippus dilate and constrict it, stretching the whole fibre field, while a soft corneal catchlight drifts across; offered as a photographic stroma, a Vesalius engraving of radial hatching, a labelled schematic of the iris zones, or a thermal fibre-density map.

energy.doc: stromal contrast / glow — brightness of the fibre field

dilate.doc: baseline pupil size (it still breathes around this)

fiber.doc: prominence of the radial trabecular fibres

furrow.doc: depth of the concentric contraction furrows

hue.doc: iris colour of the photo look (blue by default; try amber/hazel/green)

x.doc: pan the pupil across the frame

style.doc: photographic coloured stroma / monochrome radial engraving / labelled zone schematic / thermal fibre-density map
